game_title: Fallback: Code Reading Relay – Dry Well
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the caravan guide must hold off giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: In Dry Well, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Then check predicted and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sandstone arch from giant scorpions in Dry Well: keep predicted above zero until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 10, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
